name: Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing than to the pyramids

hook_variants.template: Cleopatra was born closer to the Moon landing than to the pyramids.
Who lived closer to today: Cleopatra or the pyramid builders?
The pyramids were ancient history to the ancient Egyptians.

sections.text: The Great Pyramid was built around 2560 BC. Cleopatra lived around 30 BC. Apollo 11 landed in 1969.
2030 years are between the pyramid and Cleopatra. Only 1999 years between Cleopatra and the Moon landing.
sections.title: the distances

sections.text: So the pyramid builders were farther from Cleopatra than she was from smartphones.
sections.title: the twist
sections.body: she's closer to us than to them

sections.text: Cleopatra reigned around 51 to 30 BC — closer to today than to the pyramid era.
sections.subtitle: each way, give or take

sections.text: The Romans studied pyramids the way we study Roman ruins. Ancient history layers on layers.
Follow for more facts that stretch your sense of time.

facts.claim: The Great Pyramid of Giza was completed around 2560 BC
Cleopatra ruled Egypt from 51 to 30 BC and died in 30 BC
Apollo 11 landed humans on the Moon in July 1969

titles: Cleopatra is closer to the Moon landing than to the pyramids
The ancient history that was ancient to Egypt
